name: web-synais-finance-saas-hero-maroon-with-pebble-device-and-wallet-card
title: Synais AI finance SaaS: maroon three-panel spread with a pebble-shaped device and a multi-currency wallet card
whatItIs: Three maroon panels: an 'About Us' block with mission text and stats (500+ Companies, 80% Faster Reporting, 20B+ Data Processed), a hero with 'Smarter Financial Management', Get Started/Request Demo buttons and a hand holding a glowing pebble-shaped 3D device, and a features panel with a multi-currency wallet card and a spending-overview heatmap calendar.
whatItMeans: Premium and trustworthy; the tactile pebble object gives an abstract AI finance tool a physical, brandable identity.
techniques: Invent a signature 3D object to represent an intangible AI product.
State trust stats early, before the feature list.
Use a heatmap calendar to visualise spending at a glance.

vocabulary.definition: A calendar grid coloured by a value like spend.
A custom 3D form used as a brand's visual icon.
